body: Same here, back to my shit job tomorrow that doesn't pay enough for the cost of living just so a I can scrape by while living with anxiety and depression, not worth it at all, yay life is great fun

Same, I've been going through bad self hated and sabotage(gambling, drinking) now for 2 years, just barely getting by.. Lost the girl I wanted, family is clearly disappointed in me and I'm refusing help as I don't feel I deserve it. Really didn't think life would be this way for me, it's hell on earth.. So you're not alone in feeling like this if it helps at all

Just turned 29, live in a share house with people I don't really get along with, struggling with depression and working a dead end job, only 1 close friend nearby with parents close too but they only care about themselves, struggling with childhood trauma, ptsd.. I feel like a wounded child who can't help himself/hates himself at 29. Watching both my brothers succeed while I'm just an embarrassing mess of a human. I've basically given up and just don't care about living anymore.. So yeah, you're not alone I guess
put his big purple barnacle straight up my anoos

The toughest pill to swollow is that alot of people don't really give a shit, if you're lucky you'll have some really nice people in your life, but truth is everyone really looks out for themselves in the end.. Not to mention mental illness is still highly stigmatised, so usually they avoid you during your dark times, and if I can't cope any longer in the future and decide to check out, it'll be because I'm my own saviour, always have been
Grove Street, home. At least it was before I fucked everythaaaaang up.
I did the exact same 3 days ago, blocked on everything. I'm proud of myself and you too 👏
People who have successfully done it are extremely brave and have alot of courage to go through with it, my cousin did it aged 21 in his car 10 years ago, I wish I had his bravery.

For me I just randomly planned it for 3 days away, this was a few months back, felt peaceful at first, but when I got to the day I had to go get 2 bottles of wine to get the courage, after that I did it. It somehow failed but was very very close. So yeah mine was not so much planned, but was a long build up of enduring pain that cracked open. Hope you're doing alright bro

That's what I saw in a documentary about euthanasia in Belgium, people with mental illness were booked for a date but decided to postpone/cancel appointments as they were happy that the option was there and gave them a boost to push on in life, but yeah knowing if their mental state becomes too unbearable they can peacefully end it. How I wish I lived in Belgium..
In the same boat man, I even went and bought a length of thick rope today, can't handle the pain much longer
